t: You're looking at the statue of Ernest Shackleton, a sculpture by Charles Sargeant Jagger. Shackleton was an Anglo-Irish Antarctic explorer who led three British expeditions to the Antarctic, and he's counted among the principal figures of the Heroic Age of Antarctic Exploration. Jagger served in the First World War and went on to sculpt many works on the theme of war. He's best known for his war memorials, especially the Royal Artillery Memorial at Hyde Park Corner and the Great Western Railway War Memorial at Paddington Station.
